_note: SPECS only — v1 renders nothing. gravity=attention-center means crop around the visual subject, not the geometric center. Teaser picks are SUGGESTIONS — human verifies SFW + non-spoiler before use.

site.note: The reader serves native full-resolution pages; no crops. Cover for the catalogue record comes from the cover page as-is.

patreon.note: Header crop leads the post; attach cover + teasers full-res. Full comic stays behind the paid tier / site link — never attach all pages to a public post.

deviantart.note: DA takes native aspect at full res. Mature-content flag ON. Teasers as separate deviations or a folder per house style.

twitter.note: Lead tweet: single 16:9 cover crop, or the 4-image set. Mark media sensitive if the platform requires it for this content.

instagram.note: 4:5 portrait maximizes feed real estate. IG is the strictest platform — SFW crops only; when in doubt, crop tighter or drop the slide.
